name: Dagu
description: Installs Dagu and runs its all-in-one server as an s6-overlay service.

version.description: Dagu release version to install. `latest` installs the current release.

host.description: Interface used by the Dagu server. `localhost` is normalized to `127.0.0.1`.

port.description: Port used by the Dagu server.

serviceUser.description: User account that runs Dagu and its workflows. Automatic selection prefers the remote user, container user, `vscode`, then `root`.

dnsName.description: Optional fully qualified DNS name exposed through the Caddy Feature.
